title: vLLM Qwen3 1.7B Offline Throughput Bring-Up
command: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 CUDA_DEVICE_ORDER=PCI_BUS_ID HF_HOME=tmp/hf-home-vllm HUGGINGFACE_HUB_CACHE=tmp/huggingface_cache HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1 PYTHONPATH=tmp/cuda-backend/paper-baselines/source-overlays/vllm-27fa5aa3-spinloop-cpython:tmp/cuda-backend/paper-baselines/source-overlays/vllm-27fa5aa3-spinloop-cpython/python:python:. timeout 900 tmp/cuda-backend/paper-baselines/envs/vllm-27fa5aa3/bin/python -m vllm.entrypoints.cli.main bench throughput --model Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B --dataset-name random --random-input-len 128 --random-output-len 64 --num-prompts 1 --num-warmups 1 --dtype bfloat16 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.50 --max-model-len 256 --output-json tmp/cuda-backend/paper-baselines/serving-runs/vllm/vdcores_offline_decode/vllm-throughput-qwen3-1p7b-batch1-bringup.json
observation: The isolated vLLM environment loaded cached Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B through the source overlay on one local A100, captured CUDA graphs, completed one warmup request and one measured offline-throughput request, and wrote raw throughput JSON. The first attempt with HF_HOME only failed before model load because the cache root was one directory too high; the rerun succeeded after setting HUGGINGFACE_HUB_CACHE directly to tmp/huggingface_cache.
blocker: This is not yet a paper-grade vLLM serving result: it is local A100 bring-up, uses the Qwen3-1.7B bring-up model instead of the Qwen3-8B target, and bench throughput does not emit serving TTFT/ITL metrics required before importing vllm_serving_and_throughput into viewer results.

summary.next_step: Run vllm serve plus vllm bench serve on H200 for Qwen3-8B or the agreed bring-up model so TTFT, ITL, end-to-end latency, and throughput can be imported together.
